title: Single-Cell RNA Sequencing and Assay for Transposase-Accessible Chromatin Using Sequencing Reveals Cellular and Molecular Dynamics of Aortic Aging in Mice.
authors: Xie, Wenhui; Ke, Yilang; You, Qinyi; Li, Jing; Chen, Lu; Li, Dang; Fang, Jun; Chen, Xiaofeng; Zhou, Yuanyuan; Chen, Liangwan; Hong, Huashan
one_liner_zh: 该文利用单细胞RNA测序和ATAC测序整合分析主动脉老化中的细胞异质性及TF调控网络，虽涉及TF-DNA结合位点与染色质开放性，但缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，且未聚焦三维互作建模，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作研究。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: The impact of vascular aging on cardiovascular diseases has been extensively studied; however, little is known regarding the cellular and molecular mechanisms underlying age-related vascular aging in aortic cellular subpopulations. Approach and Results: Transcriptomes and transposase-accessible chromatin profiles from the aortas of 4-, 26-, and 86-week-old C57/BL6J mice were analyzed using single-cell RNA sequencing and assay for transposase-accessible chromatin sequencing. By integrating the heterogeneous transcriptome and chromatin accessibility data, we identified cell-specific TF (transcription factor) regulatory networks and open chromatin states. We also determined that aortic aging affects cell interactions, inflammation, cell type composition, dysregulation of transcriptional control, and chromatin accessibility. Endothelial cells 1 have higher gene set activity related to cellular senescence and aging than do endothelial cells 2. Moreover, construction of senescence trajectories shows that endothelial cell 1 and fibroblast senescence is associated with distinct TF open chromatin states and an mRNA expression model. CONCLUSIONS: Our data provide a system-wide model for transcriptional and epigenetic regulation during aortic aging at single-cell resolution.
abstract_zh: 目的：血管老化对心血管疾病的影响已被广泛研究；然而，关于主动脉细胞亚群中与年龄相关血管老化相关的细胞和分子机制知之甚少。方法与结果：使用单细胞RNA测序和转座酶可及染色质测序分析了4周、26周和86周龄C57/BL6J小鼠主动脉的转录组和转座酶可及染色质谱。通过整合异质性转录组和染色质可及性数据，我们鉴定了细胞特异性转录因子（TF）调控网络和开放染色质状态。我们还确定主动脉老化影响细胞相互作用、炎症、细胞类型组成、转录控制失调和染色质可及性。内皮细胞1在与细胞衰老和老化相关的基因集活性上高于内皮细胞2。此外，构建衰老轨迹显示，内皮细胞1和成纤维细胞的衰老与独特的TF开放染色质状态和mRNA表达模型相关。结论：我们的数据提供了单细胞分辨率下主动脉老化过程中转录和表观遗传调控的系统级模型。
